globalOptions.name: version
globalOptions.description: print the version number of mkfs.erofs and exit

globalOptions.name: help
globalOptions.description: display this help and exit

globalOptions.name: B
globalOptions.description: set block size to # (# = page size by default)

globalOptions.name: D
globalOptions.description: set output verbosity; 0=quiet, 9=verbose (default=2)

globalOptions.name: X
globalOptions.description: set xattr tolerance to # (< 0, disable xattrs; default 2)

globalOptions.name: Z
globalOptions.description: [,level=Y]         X=compressor (Y=compression level, Z=dictionary size, optional)

globalOptions.name: C
globalOptions.description: specify the size of compress physical cluster in bytes

globalOptions.name: E
globalOptions.description: [,...]             X=extended options

globalOptions.name: L
globalOptions.description: set the volume label (maximum 15 bytes)

globalOptions.name: T
globalOptions.description: specify a fixed UNIX timestamp # as build time

globalOptions.name: allTime
globalOptions.description: the timestamp is also applied to all files (default)

globalOptions.name: mkfsTime
globalOptions.description: the timestamp is applied as build time only

globalOptions.name: U
globalOptions.description: use a given filesystem UUID

globalOptions.name: allRoot
globalOptions.description: make all files owned by root

globalOptions.name: blobdev
globalOptions.description: specify an extra device X to store chunked data

globalOptions.name: chunksize
globalOptions.description: generate chunk-based files with #-byte chunks

globalOptions.name: clean
globalOptions.description: run full clean build (default) or:

globalOptions.name: incremental
globalOptions.description: run incremental build

globalOptions.name: compressHints
globalOptions.description: specify a file to configure per-file compression strategy

globalOptions.name: excludePath
globalOptions.description: avoid including file X (X = exact literal path)

globalOptions.name: excludeRegex
globalOptions.description: avoid including files that match X (X = regular expression)

globalOptions.name: fileContexts
globalOptions.description: specify a file contexts file to setup selinux labels

globalOptions.name: forceUid
globalOptions.description: set all file uids to # (# = UID)

globalOptions.name: forceGid
globalOptions.description: set all file gids to # (# = GID)

globalOptions.name: uidOffset
globalOptions.description: add offset # to all file uids (# = id offset)

globalOptions.name: gidOffset
globalOptions.description: add offset # to all file gids (# = id offset)

globalOptions.name: hardDereference
globalOptions.description: dereference hardlinks, add links as separate inodes

globalOptions.name: ignoreMtime
globalOptions.description: use build time instead of strict per-file modification time

globalOptions.name: maxExtentBytes
globalOptions.description: set maximum decompressed extent size # in bytes

globalOptions.name: mountPoint
globalOptions.description: X=prefix of target fs path (default: /)

globalOptions.name: preserveMtime
globalOptions.description: keep per-file modification time strictly

globalOptions.name: offset
globalOptions.description: skip # bytes at the beginning of IMAGE.

globalOptions.name: rootXattrIsize
globalOptions.description: ensure the inline xattr size of the root directory is # bytes at least

globalOptions.name: aufs
globalOptions.description: replace aufs special files with overlayfs metadata

globalOptions.name: sort
globalOptions.description: data sorting order for tarballs as input (default: path)

globalOptions.name: tar
globalOptions.description: generate a full or index-only image from a tarball(-ish) source

globalOptions.name: ovlfsStrip
globalOptions.description: strip overlayfs metadata in the target image (e.g. whiteouts)

globalOptions.name: quiet
globalOptions.description: quiet execution (do not write anything to standard output.)

globalOptions.name: ungzip
globalOptions.description: try to filter the tarball stream through gzip

globalOptions.name: unxz
globalOptions.description: try to filter the tarball stream through xz/lzma/lzip

globalOptions.name: workers
globalOptions.description: set the number of worker threads to # (default: 16)

globalOptions.name: xattrPrefix
globalOptions.description: X=extra xattr name prefix

globalOptions.name: zfeatureBits
globalOptions.description: toggle filesystem compression features according to given bits #

globalOptions.name: productOut
globalOptions.description: X=product_out directory

globalOptions.name: fsConfigFile
globalOptions.description: X=fs_config file

globalOptions.name: blockListFile
globalOptions.description: X=block_list file

commands.name: execute
commands.description: Execute the tool with its options and positional operands
